title: Mirror a site tree with exclude and protect rules
notes: skill: one-way directory sync (rsync-like) with exclude/protect glob rules, deletions, empty-dir pruning and an action log; traps: same-size content changes (rsync quick-check with equal mtimes misses them), directory patterns, protected files that differ in src, excluded files left alone in dst (knob 4), anchored path patterns vs nested look-alikes and spaces (knob 5); pass_guess_permille: 400
